title: Toy discussion (invented, not a real PEP)

posts.author: ana
posts.text: I propose we add a new keyword for async context managers. How about reusing the existing with keyword instead?

posts.author: ben
posts.text: Reusing the with keyword is not worth it because it would break existing parsers. I am against it.

posts.author: ana
posts.text: Fair point, I am dropping that idea.

posts.author: cho
posts.text: We should postpone the syntax change for now and revisit it later.

posts.author: ben
posts.text: We should add the new keyword. LGTM, approved.
